customers.evidence: Patients are at the center of everything we do.

employees.evidence: Each day, our employees around the world work together for patients

dei.evidence: Our workforce is globally diverse to create an inclusive, high-performance culture that is agile, entrepreneurial and accountable.

environment.evidence: Preservation of natural resources is one of our key commitments.

community.evidence: As global citizens, we work sustainably, responsibly and seek to give back.

integrity.evidence: commit us to the highest standard of moral and ethical behavior

innovation.evidence: discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases

result.analyst_notes: Patient-centred, mission-led framing with collective first-person 'we' and mostly absolute commitments ('one of our key commitments', 'essential to our integrity'). Patients are addressed first, before employees and community. Ethics is anchored in a quoted maxim. Shareholder and safety themes are absent, and environment and DEI get brief, generic treatment.
